posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Katrina's team has officially dismissed reports of an OTT comeback, calling them 'speculation and misinformation.' The actress continues to enjoy motherhood with son Vihaan and husband Vicky Kaushal.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Diljit's Main Vaapas Aaunga with Imtiaz Ali and AR Rahman hit theatres today. He also released 'Kya Kamaal Hai,' a song dedicated to refugees worldwide, while continuing his AURA Tour 2026.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: The Alpha teaser just dropped and clocked 75M+ views in 24 hours. Alia plays a deadly assassin in the first female-led YRF Spy Universe film, releasing July 3. SS Rajamouli called her 'outstanding.'

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Priyanka ranked #3 on Fortune India's inaugural Most Valuable Celebrities 2026 list — the only woman on their standalone covers. She's currently shooting SS Rajamouli's Varanasi with Mahesh Babu.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: SRK ranked #2 on Fortune India's Most Valuable Celebrities 2026. His upcoming film King with Deepika Padukone and daughter Suhana Khan has moved its release date, with reports eyeing a December 2026 slot.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Kareena is set to star in Meghna Gulzar's hard-hitting film Daayra alongside Ayushmann Khurrana, based on the Hyderabad rape case. She's currently enjoying a London vacation with Saif Ali Khan.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Shraddha's biopic Eetha has locked an August 28 release — she plays legendary Lavani performer Vithabai Narayangaonkar. She's also in talks to star opposite Vicky Kaushal in the mythological drama Mahavatar.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Deepika returns to the big screen in King alongside Shah Rukh Khan — their 6th collaboration after Pathaan and Jawan. After embracing motherhood in 2025, she's gearing up for a major comeback.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Ranveer's Dhurandhar franchise is unstoppable — the TV premiere set a 5-year record, Dhurandhar 2 is #1 on JioHotstar, and the franchise nears ₹1,800 Cr worldwide. Dhurandhar heads to Japan on July 10.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: A 23-year-old dance clip of Aishwarya from an unreleased film has gone viral, reminding fans of her timeless grace. The former Miss World continues to be one of India's most iconic global faces.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Rashmika's Cocktail 2 with Shahid Kapoor releases June 19 — it's already #1 on IMDb's most anticipated Indian movies list. She also wrapped the 5th schedule of her action-thriller Mysa.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Samantha's Maa Inti Bangaaram hits theatres June 19 — her debut as a producer. She performs intense action sequences in a saree without a body double in this family action drama directed by Nandini Reddy.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Allu Arjun cracked Fortune India's Top 10 Most Valuable Celebrities. His next film Raaka with director Atlee is a VFX-heavy sci-fi spectacle — expected to be the biggest Pan-India release of 2027.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Ram Charan's Peddi is a massive hit — nearing ₹250 Cr worldwide and topping the UK box office with 6x more than Bollywood rivals. The film with Janhvi Kapoor has crossed ₹200 Cr India gross.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Jr NTR's Dragon with KGF director Prashanth Neel is locked for June 2027. Reports also claim his son Bhargava Ram has been roped in to play young Mahesh Babu in Rajamouli's Varanasi.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Janhvi is riding the massive success of Peddi alongside Ram Charan — one of the most celebrated on-screen pairings of 2026. The film has been dominating box offices in India and the UK.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Ananya's romantic drama Chand Mera Dil with Lakshya is one of the most anticipated new-age pairings of 2026. The film is generating strong buzz for its youthful, emotionally charged storyline.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Kiara stars in Toxic: A Fairy Tale for Grown-Ups alongside Yash — the most expensive Indian film ever at ₹850 Cr. The period gangster film's release is delayed as makers align global distribution.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Hrithik just signed with Hollywood powerhouse Anonymous Content (behind Spotlight and The Revenant), sparking massive Hollywood debut speculation. He's also prepping Krrish 4 and producing Storm for Prime Video.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Varun's rom-com Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai with dad David Dhawan is in theatres now — a classic comedy of errors with Pooja Hegde and Mrunal Thakur that's bringing back vintage Dhawan humor.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Shreya's Unstoppable Tour hits Australia and New Zealand starting June 20, followed by a massive 10-city North American leg in September. 21 concerts spanning 6 countries — tickets selling fast.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: Rahman's music for Main Vaapas Aaunga (with Imtiaz Ali and Diljit) releases today in theatres. He's also confirmed to compose for Mani Ratnam's new film with Vijay Sethupathi and Sai Pallavi.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Vijay's final film Jananayagan continues to build massive hype as the superstar transitions to politics. His Thalapathy Kacheri event drew 2.5M real-time views, with fans celebrating his cinematic legacy.
